raw_description_html:
Breathe in. Give thanks.

Ukiyo Inspire Gratitude is a blend of pure essential oils made for moments of reflection and appreciation. Add a few drops to your diffuser while you journal, meditate or sit with your morning tea, and let the aroma mark a pause in your day.

Ways to use it

  • Diffuse: add a few drops to your diffuser during meditation, journaling or quiet time.
  • On skin: always dilute with a carrier oil first.

Why you'll love it

  • Pure, undiluted essential oils
  • Made for mindful rituals: meditation, journaling, slow mornings
  • A generous 120 ml bottle

Never apply undiluted to skin. Not for internal use. Keep away from infants, children and pets. If you are pregnant, nursing or under medical care, ask your doctor before use.
